articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Enhanced Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: OpenAI has unveiled GPT-5 Turbo, a faster and more cost-efficient variant of its flagship model featuring a 2 million token context window and significant improvements to multi-step reasoning tasks. The model demonstrates a 40% reduction in hallucination rates on standard benchmarks compared to its predecessor. Enterprise customers will gain access first, with broader rollout expected by end of July.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaAgent Framework Completes Autonomous Scientific Experiments at Scale
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing its AlphaAgent system autonomously designed, executed, and interpreted over 1,200 biology experiments in a six-week period without human intervention. The system identified three novel protein interaction candidates that human researchers are now pursuing for drug discovery applications. The paper, released on arXiv, is being called a landmark moment for agentic AI in scientific research.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI 2.0 to Address Jailbreak Vulnerabilities
articles.summary: Anthropic has announced Constitutional AI 2.0, an updated safety framework designed to close persistent jailbreak exploits that have plagued large language models across the industry. The new system uses a dynamic rule-updating mechanism that adapts to novel adversarial prompting strategies in near real-time. Safety researchers have given cautious praise, noting independent evaluations are still needed to verify the claims.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Now Supports Full RAG Pipeline Configuration for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
articles.summary: Microsoft has rolled out a major update to Copilot Studio that allows enterprise developers to configure end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation pipelines directly within the platform, including custom chunking strategies and hybrid vector-keyword search. The update integrates natively with Azure AI Search and supports ingestion from SharePoint, OneDrive, and third-party data lakes. Analysts say the move significantly lowers the barrier for large organizations to deploy production-grade RAG applications.

articles.title: Meta's Chameleon 3 Multimodal Model Achieves State-of-the-Art on Video Understanding Benchmarks
articles.summary: Meta AI released Chameleon 3, a natively multimodal model that processes interleaved text, images, and video in a unified architecture without modality-specific encoders. The model sets new records on EgoSchema and Video-MME benchmarks, outperforming GPT-5V and Gemini 2.0 Ultra on temporal reasoning tasks. Meta has open-sourced the weights under a research license on Hugging Face.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine Against Undisclosed AI-Generated Content
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office levied a €47 million fine against a major European media conglomerate for systematically publishing AI-generated news articles without required disclosure labels, marking the first significant enforcement action under the AI Act. The ruling sets a precedent for how generative content transparency requirements will be interpreted across member states. Industry groups have called for clearer technical guidelines to avoid inadvertent non-compliance.

articles.title: LangChain Launches LangGraph Cloud with Persistent Memory and Cross-Session Agent State
articles.summary: LangChain has officially launched LangGraph Cloud, a managed platform for deploying stateful multi-agent workflows that maintains persistent memory and task context across sessions and users. The service includes built-in observability tooling, human-in-the-loop checkpointing, and support for branching agent execution graphs. Early adopters report the platform dramatically simplifies the operationalization of complex agentic pipelines that previously required significant custom infrastructure.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI Energy Consumption Threatening Climate Goals
articles.summary: A comprehensive report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute estimates that global AI compute consumption will surpass the electricity usage of Germany by the end of 2026, raising urgent questions about sustainability. The report highlights that the rapid deployment of inference infrastructure for agentic and multimodal workloads is growing three times faster than anticipated in previous projections. Researchers are calling on policymakers and hyperscalers to establish binding efficiency standards before the next generation of model deployments.
